newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $3.6 bln for April 21 week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $3.6 bln for April 21 week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of April 21 are expected to total $3.6 billion in 103 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $3 billion in 38 sales, with a $920 million Port Authority of N.Y. & N.J. through Smith Barney Inc. is topping the list.
On the competitive side, 65 sales totaling $583 million are on the schedule. A $44 million Norfolk, Va., deal on Wednesday is the largest.
An additional eight sales totaling $570 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds this week, depending on market conditions.
